prs.title: fix(managed-agent): recover committed wakes after writer loss
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Automatically reattach public Sessions that retain committed, unconsumed Monitor/background Shell, channel, child-result, workflow, Automation or Session-message inputs after their Harness writer expires. An independent SQL scan uses a revision-stamped hint, a durable retry delay and verified journal settlement; the existing Harness wake pump executes or reconciles the original input. Recovery forces a passive generation round trip even when the connector still has a cached attachment. Hinted work precedes historical backfill, and new empty heads carry a proven revision-zero stamp.

Preserve Workspace/tenant/CSI and lifecycle fencing, source retry/give-up semantics, and honest unknown outcomes. Closing an unbound public Session now also fences ordinary writer acquisition, including a recovery claimed before close. Recovery claims follow the normal Session-before-head lock order. Stopped or terminal child runs never resume. Channel recovery uses its own interruption settlement, preserves queued inputs and held approvals, and blocks a fresh prompt while Runtime recovery is parked. Passive attachment publication and recovery markers remain consistent across concurrent Harness generation adoption.

## Why it's needed

A replacement Harness starts with an empty Session map. Source relays can already be finished, and an MQ wake consumed while the old writer still owns its lease does not come back after expiry. Previously, committed work could remain pending indefinitely until unrelated activity loaded that Session. The scan discovers that work independently of MQ and does not resubmit a source operation or replay tool effects.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Commit a supported wake input, terminate and replace the Harness before consumption, then send no new input. After the old writer lease expires and a due scan succeeds, the original input should load and settle once. An already-attempted input should retain its source-specific crash aftermath rather than execute again. Repeat with an already-claimed MQ watermark, an unavailable load and a stale connector attachment.

A live writer, wrong tenant/Workspace, private CSI Session, or closing/closed Session must remain fenced. Close a public Session after recovery has claimed it: subsequent ordinary writer acquisition must be rejected and no model request or journal advancement may occur. Concurrent admission must survive an older scan, and a legacy writer's stale discovery stamp must remain stale through an unrelated modern commit. Exercise channel recovery with interrupted Runtime work, an unattempted queued input, a pending approval and a transient refusal. Attempt a fresh prompt during the parked work: it must be refused without admitting input. Race passive load completion with generation adoption before and after attachment publication: a late old boot must not displace a current ref or its recovery marker.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Initial process evidence before review fixes: a real Harness restart on main `46bf492d05` left the monitor input pending with zero automatic loads after lease expiry; an explicit load consumed it. After: real Spring/MySQL/Harness probes automatically restored monitor, actual Automation fire and actual channel input in 34–37 seconds, with one matching settlement and no duplicate during a further 35-second observation. An interrupted attempted Automation retained `outcome_unknown`, one model request and one model-side sentinel. A separate close-race probe on refreshed main `d51f4a6bd2` now returns writer-acquire `409 managed_session_not_writable`, makes zero post-close model calls and preserves the head.

Review-fix validation: root build, typecheck and bundle; affected TypeScript lint; 37 channel/reconcile route tests and 47 wake runner tests; 134 focused Java tests. The complete Java unit suite ran 4,689 tests with zero failures/errors and 18 predefined skips. The non-Hosted MySQL run covered 857 cases: 833 cases outside the corrected lifecycle class passed in the broad run, and the corrected 24-case class passed its final recheck. This includes 15 passing wake-recovery MySQL cases. The matching Hosted/MySQL and process-crash verification passed four test methods, including coordinator restart and all six physical fault cuts. Checkstyle and SpotBugs reported zero issues. Markdown formatting and added relative references pass. Independent latch probes verify the attachment/marker publication races against fingerprinted source; these probes are not real process-fault acceptance.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ JDK 21, Node 24, MySQL 8.4, real local Harness processes |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Disposable MySQL 8.4 on a task-owned port, real Spring control plane and locally built Harness, deterministic local model. Installed global qwen 0.25.2 explicitly lacks this Hosted loop, so baseline and fixed process probes use the local bundle.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: discovery repeats complete-history proof after a new journal revision, cache eviction or restart; at most 128 immutable positive prefixes are cached. One transaction per page bounds materialized stored bytes to 8 MiB, not total proof time. Ineligible historical heads can remain in the scan index permanently. Resumable proof and lifecycle/index cleanup are explicitly deferred capacity work; a budget that always restarts at revision zero would permanently exclude long journals. Large histories/catalogs can delay the single scanner. The default cadence is two seconds, eight returned candidates and a durable 30-second retry delay.
- Not validated / out of scope: local MariaDB execution, a real MQ-on broker, physical background Shell wake production, child/workflow/message relationship process acceptance, external channel delivery, deployed or cross-platform acceptance. Generic journal tests cover all six source names; these do not establish provider acceptance.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive V11 columns/index on the existing head table; published V1–V10 and the 32-table baseline remain unchanged. Upgrade Server and Broker together; rollback binaries must understand V11. Includes an indentation-only repair for the Runtime Broker Checkstyle failure found during baseline verification and native storage registration in the fault fixture for already-supported macOS.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/hosted-wake-recovery-14116/docs/design/2026-10-18-hosted-wake-recovery.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/hosted-wake-recovery-14116/docs/design/2026-10-18-hosted-wake-recovery.zh-CN.md), complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14116

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的变更

Harness writer 租约到期后，自动重新附着仍保留已提交、未消费 Monitor/后台 Shell、channel、child-result、workflow、Automation 或 Session message 输入的公共 Session。独立 SQL 扫描使用版本戳提示、持久化重试间隔及已验证的日志结算事实；现有 Harness wake pump 执行或协调原始输入。即使 connector 仍有缓存附着，恢复也会强制进行被动的 generation 往返验证。有工作提示的候选优先于历史回填，新建空 head 将已证明的空前缀标记为 revision 0。

保留 Workspace、tenant、CSI 和生命周期围栏、来源重试/放弃语义及真实的未知结果。关闭未绑定 Workspace 的公共 Session 也会阻止普通 writer 获取，包括关闭之前已领取的恢复任务。恢复认领遵循普通路径先 Session、后 head 的锁顺序。已停止或终态的 child run 不会恢复。channel 使用自身中断结算路径，保留排队输入和待审批状态，并在 Runtime 恢复停放时拒绝新 prompt。被动附着和恢复标记的发布在并发 Harness 代际接管下保持一致。

## 必要性

替代 Harness 启动时 Session map 为空。来源 relay 可能已经结束，旧 writer 仍持有租约时被消费的 MQ wake 也不会在租约到期后再次到达。此前，已提交工作可能无限等待，直到无关活动加载该 Session。扫描独立于 MQ 发现这些工作，不重新发送来源操作或重放工具效果。

## 审阅测试计划

### 如何验证

提交支持来源的 wake 输入，在消费之前终止并替换 Harness，之后不发送新输入。旧 writer 租约到期且到期扫描成功后，原始输入应被加载并结算一次。已经尝试的输入应保留其来源特定的崩溃结算，不再次执行。覆盖 MQ 水位已认领、load 暂时不可用及 connector 缓存过期的情况。

活 writer、错误 tenant/Workspace、私有 CSI、关闭中或已关闭 Session 必须保持隔离。在恢复认领之后关闭公共 Session：后续普通 writer 获取应被拒绝，不调用模型、不推进日志。旧扫描不能清掉并发准入；旧二进制留下的过期发现版本戳经过无关的新二进制提交后仍必须保持过期。覆盖 channel 的 Runtime 中断、未尝试排队输入、待审批和暂时拒绝；恢复停放期间的新 prompt 必须被拒绝且不准入。让被动 load 在附着发布前后与代际接管交错：迟到旧 boot 不得替换当前 ref 或删除其恢复标记。

### 修复前后证据

评审修复前的初始进程证据：真实 Harness 在 main `46bf492d05` 重启后，monitor 输入在租约到期后仍未消费、自动 load 为零；显式 load 后才消费。修复后：真实 Spring/MySQL/Harness 探针在 34–37 秒内自动恢复 monitor、实际 Automation fire 和实际 channel 输入，均有一次匹配结算，额外观察 35 秒没有重复。被中断的已尝试 Automation 保持 `outcome_unknown`，模型请求及模型侧哨兵各一次。基于刷新后 main `d51f4a6bd2` 的独立关闭竞态探针，现在返回 writer-acquire `409 managed_session_not_writable`，关闭后模型调用为零，head 不变。

评审修复验证：根目录 build、typecheck、bundle 和受影响 TypeScript lint 通过；37 项 channel/reconcile 路由测试、47 项 wake runner 测试及 134 项针对性 Java 测试通过。完整 Java 单测执行 4,689 项，失败和错误为零，18 项按预设条件跳过。 非 Hosted MySQL 共覆盖 857 项：全量运行中该生命周期类之外的 833 项通过，修正后的 24 项类已单独复验通过；包含 15 项 wake recovery MySQL 测试。 匹配的 Hosted/MySQL 和进程崩溃验证通过四个测试方法，覆盖协调器重启与全部六处物理故障注入；Checkstyle 和 SpotBugs 均为零问题。 Markdown 格式和新增相对引用检查通过。独立 latch 探针对照带指纹源码验证附着与恢复标记发布的竞态，不将其视作真实进程故障验收。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ JDK 21、Node 24、MySQL 8.4、真实本地 Harness 进程 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未本地验证 |

### 环境

任务独立端口的一次性 MySQL 8.4、真实 Spring 控制面及本地构建 Harness、确定性的本地模型。已安装的全局 qwen 0.25.2 明确未实现该 Hosted 循环，因此基线和修复后的进程探针均使用本地 bundle。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：新日志版本、缓存逐出或重启后都会重复完整历史证明；最多缓存 128 个不可变正向前缀。每页一个事务将物化存储字节限制为 8 MiB，不限制整次证明时间。不合格历史 head 可能永久保留在扫描索引中。可续算证明及生命周期/索引清理明确延后为容量工作；总从 revision 0 重启的固定预算会永久排除长日志。大规模历史和目录会延迟单个扫描器。默认每两秒扫描、返回八个候选、持久化重试间隔 30 秒。
- 未验证或不在范围内：本地 MariaDB 执行、真实开启 MQ 的代理、物理后台 Shell wake 生产、child/workflow/message 关系进程验收、外部 channel 投递、部署及跨平台验收。通用日志测试覆盖全部六个来源名称，但不证明 provider 验收。
- 兼容性与迁移：在现有 head 表追加 V11 列和索引；不修改已发布 V1–V10 和 32 表基线。Server 与 Broker 一起升级；回滚二进制必须理解 V11。包含针对基线验证中发现的 Runtime Broker Checkstyle 失败的纯缩进修正，并为已有支持的 macOS 补齐故障夹具的原生存储注册。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/hosted-wake-recovery-14116/docs/design/2026-10-18-hosted-wake-recovery.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/hosted-wake-recovery-14116/docs/design/2026-10-18-hosted-wake-recovery.zh-CN.md)，内容完整同步。

## 关联 Issue

修复 #14116。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): bootstrap the shared deployment credentials
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The distribution now ships a credential bootstrap. It generates the shared Harness token and capability digest, the broker token and a 32-byte Runtime credential key, then writes the Harness environment, the server environment and the key-ring configuration with mode 0600. It refuses to overwrite existing files unless forced, prints paths rather than secrets, and is included in the archive alongside a shell shim.

This PR is stacked on the systemd branch. That base must merge first because the install guide now points at the bootstrap as the alternative to editing the environment templates by hand.

## Why it's needed

Every deployment had to mint four credentials and keep the Harness token and capability digest identical across two files, with the credential key in a third. A mismatch surfaced only when the first Turn failed. The generator removes the manual minting and the cross-file alignment, and it keeps secret material out of shell history.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the bootstrap into a temporary directory. Confirm all three files exist with mode 0600, the token and digest match across the two environment files, the credential key decodes to 32 bytes, and stdout contains no secret value. Run it again without a flag: it must refuse and exit 1. Run it with the force flag: it must overwrite. Then run the server preflight against the generated files; the configuration and key-ring rows must pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI change). The generated files are private:

```
-rw-------  application.yml
-rw-------  harness.env
-rw-------  server.env
```

The preflight against those files reports `config PASS` and `key-ring PASS active=<id>`; the Harness and database rows fail only because neither runs locally.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

## What this PR does

The reference distribution now ships systemd units, environment templates and a bilingual install guide for the accepted single-host topology. The control-plane unit uses `KillMode=process` and a managed state directory so Runtime workers survive a Broker restart; the Harness unit uses `KillMode=mixed` so its tool processes terminate with it. MySQL stays outside the units.

This PR is stacked on the preflight branch. That base must merge first because the archive, the packaging test and the deployment documentation already share the sections and files introduced there.

## Why it's needed

The server reference required a supervisor that leaves Runtime workers running across a Broker restart, and warned that the default control-group kill terminates them with the server. The distribution shipped no unit that did so. Operators had to translate that paragraph into a unit themselves, and the same document had no answer for the Harness lifecycle.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Extract the archive and confirm the systemd directory, both units, both environment templates and the install guide are present. Review the control-plane unit for the process kill mode, the state directory, the environment file and the launcher path. Review the Harness unit for the hosted-harness profile, the no-web flag, the mixed kill mode and its state directory. The packaging unit test asserts those directives, the trailing newline and the absence of tabs.

The units were reviewed statically. They were not executed here because the local environment has no systemd, and `systemd-analyze verify` was not run.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI change; no running systemd in the local environment).

prs.title: test(managed-agent): drain a held async Hook before the lifecycle Hooks on DELETE
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the FG13d DELETE async-drain arm. The cell admits an async `PreToolUse` command that holds with a descendant ignoring SIGTERM, then deletes the Session. DELETE must empty the in-flight Hook unit before the lifecycle Hooks run, so the cell asserts the unit is gone and `SessionEnd` and `SessionDelete` each ran exactly once.

The fixture now records each Hook's `hook_event_name` and answers non-`PreToolUse` events without a `PreToolUse` decision, recording `hook.done` instead of `hook.allow`. `boot()` gained a lifecycle variant that registers the three Hooks; the existing four cells keep the single synchronous Hook.

The shared fork grows by 150 s: healthy 6985 s, fork 7585 s, Verify 137 minutes and the job 230.

## Why it's needed

FG13d lists DELETE with an acknowledged async Hook as its async-drain arm: a drain that runs `SessionEnd`/`SessionDelete` before the held command is gone would retire a Session that still holds cgroup work. No IT covers it today.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the `Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21` lane on this branch; PR events only run the fast tier, so the lane must be dispatched manually. The cell lives in `HostedHookCancelFaultGatesIT`.

For the mutation witness, skip the async drain before the lifecycle events, so `SessionEnd` runs while the unit is still populated; the drain-order and unit assertions fail.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change, no user-visible behavior.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS covers Java compilation, both checkstyle executions, the CI meta-test and Prettier. The class is Linux-only and needs MySQL 8.4 plus a delegated cgroup v2 root, so the lane is the evidence.

### Environment (optional)

Local: JDK 21, `mvn -o test-compile`, `mvn -o checkstyle:check checkstyle:check@runtime-broker-checkstyle`, `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` (57 passed) and Prettier.

## Risk & Scope

- The DELETE admission with an active turn is the lane's job to confirm: a refusal surfaces as a 409 on the DELETE request, not as a timeout.
- Not validated / out of scope: cancel before dispatch, the rest of FG13a, FG13b, FG13e and FG13f.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Test, fixture, CI-budget and design-document files only.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-18-hosted-hook-cancel-drain-gates-d.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-18-hosted-hook-cancel-drain-gates-d.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Part of #14449.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

补上 FG13d 的 DELETE 异步 drain 臂。该格先让一个 async `PreToolUse` 命令带一个忽略 SIGTERM 的后代保持运行，再删除 Session。DELETE 必须先清空在飞的 Hook 单元，再运行生命周期 Hook，因此该格断言单元已空、且 `SessionEnd` 与 `SessionDelete` 各运行一次。

夹具现在记录每个 Hook 的 `hook_event_name`，且非 `PreToolUse` 事件不写 `PreToolUse` 决策，改记 `hook.done`。`boot()` 新增生命周期变体注册三个 Hook；现有四格仍用单个同步 Hook。

共享 fork 增加 150 秒：healthy 6985、fork 7585、Verify 137 分钟、job 230。

## 为什么需要

FG13d 把「带已确认 async Hook 的 DELETE」列为异步 drain 臂：若在被持有命令尚未消失时就跑 `SessionEnd`/`SessionDelete`，就会退役一个仍占着 cgroup 工作的 Session。当前没有任何 IT 覆盖。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在本分支上手动派发 `Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21` 车道（PR 事件只跑 fast 档）。该格位于 `HostedHookCancelFaultGatesIT`。

变异见证：在生命周期事件前跳过 async drain，`SessionEnd` 会在单元仍被占据时运行，drain 顺序与单元断言失败。

### 证据（修改前后）

N/A —— 仅测试改动，无用户可见行为。

### 测试环境

macOS 覆盖 Java 编译、两个 checkstyle execution、CI 元测试与 Prettier。该类是 Linux-only，需要 MySQL 8.4 与委派 cgroup v2 根，因此车道才是证据。

prs.title: fix(serve): stop renewing settled Hosted Shell grants
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Stops renewing a Hosted Shell publication once the original execution has authoritatively settled, while retaining its binding until receipt acceptance so failure cleanup still works. Each renewal pass attempts all live bindings before reporting failures with their publication IDs. A renewal already in flight when settlement is observed can finish without producing a misleading warning; genuine renewal failures still block dispatch.

## Why it's needed

A slow Session receipt leaves the settled execution in the batch's bookkeeping. The publication service correctly rejects renewal of settled executions, but the client previously kept renewing them and logged a misleading warning. The first rejection also prevented queued publications later in the same pass from being renewed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Hold the first Shell execution open in a two-call batch and advance the renewal timer. Both its running publication and the queued second publication should renew.
2. Settle the first execution, hold its receipt commit across two timer ticks, and check that only the queued publication renews. Release the receipt: both calls should complete, ownership should release normally, and no publication-renewal warning should appear. Repeat for original-finished-publication recovery and a proven not-started execution.
3. Let an already-running renewal reject after settlement is observed. It should not warn or prevent renewal of the queued publication.
4. Reject an unsettled timer renewal with HTTP 503. The same tick should still renew the queued publication and log exactly one warning naming the failed publication. The next successful tick should retry both live publications. HTTP 400 or 503 during pre-dispatch renewal must still block dispatch after attempting all bindings.
5. Return cancelled-before-dispatch with no capture, then reject the finished-publication lookup. Recovery must cancel the original execution and send close_not_started with the original publication ID and token, without releasing uncertain ownership.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for visual evidence: internal Hosted lifecycle behavior, no TUI layout change. With the original eight regression tests on unchanged base 8eaaa1355cafbd0ae2716331b0eca57dec54b2e6, seven cases fail and the cleanup-preservation case passes. Settled publications are renewed, delayed receipts produce spurious warnings and skip queued grants, and genuine per-binding errors stop the renewal pass. The exact same eight cases all pass with the fix. After the fix, all 581 Hosted CLI tests (15 files) and 1,927 managed-runtime core tests (34 files) pass, 2,508 in total. Full build, full typecheck (4 GiB Node heap), bundle, repository-wide lint:ci, changed-file Prettier, diff whitespace checks, and the serve-fast-path bundle closure check also pass.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ 304 scoped Hosted-turn tests on head d39e83a31 (2026-10-19) |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ deterministic component tests |

### Environment (optional)

Debian 13, Node.js 24.19.0, repository-pinned pnpm 11.24.0. Usage statistics and OTel are disabled with QWEN_USAGE_STATISTICS_ENABLED=false and QWEN_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false. The component tests exercise the actual Hosted turn coordinator and local Session/harness persistence with controlled Broker and publication-service fixtures. Only interval timers are advanced. The global qwen CLI is unavailable in this environment.

Latest upstream-merge validation (2026-10-07, head b6ee9a1ac6a8): 210 Hosted-turn tests, changed-file Prettier/ESLint, CLI typecheck, and full build/bundle passed on Windows. The wider Linux counts above describe the original fix validation, not a new full-suite run on this head.

Review follow-up (2026-10-11, head 91b3bf80a): collected renewal failures retain their binding reference and are filtered again against current settlement state when the pass finishes. The new regression rejects the first renewal before client settlement, then holds the second renewal until the first receipt and ACK complete. With catch-time-only filtering it rejects the turn with HostedToolRecoveryRequiredError; with the correction both calls and ACKs complete with zero cancellation and no renewal warning. Independent verification: 217/217 Hosted-turn tests and 9/9 renewal cases, including HTTP 400/503 pre-dispatch fail-closed and cleanup. Changed-file formatting/lint, full workspace+integration typecheck, CLI rebuild, bundle, and compiled CLI version smoke check pass. A fresh frozen-lockfile installation did not complete because registry requests/foreign-platform cache metadata were unavailable; these checks use the existing locked-version dependency cache. No real remote-service E2E or full-repository unit-suite pass is claimed. Retry-policy changes and store/client settlement-lag confirmation remain non-blocking follow-ups; this correction does not infer settlement from HTTP 400 or message text.

Maintenance follow-up (2026-10-13, head 0aa39cf07): merged main ef38ad775 normally, including upstream #13844's Git fanout-fixture correction. Production renewal behavior is unchanged by this round. Added mixed stale/live and multiple-live-failure coverage for R2-3/R2-4: only the stale error is discarded, the queued live failure still blocks dispatch, and both live publication IDs are retained in the aggregate and its single warning. Independent mutation checks turn red when the entire pass is swallowed or the aggregate message is truncated to the first error; after restoration, 222/222 Hosted-turn tests and 11/11 renewal cases pass. Frozen-lockfile installation and its 2,075 supply-chain checks, full workspace prepare/build/bundle, CLI typecheck, changed-file formatting/lint, pre-commit hooks and compiled CLI version smoke (0.25.1) pass. This is component verification, not a full repository unit run or real-service E2E. The unrelated BranchPickerPopover focus failure is already tracked by upstream #12427; no competing UI fix was added. New-head cloud CI and formal review are still pending.

### Latest upstream synchronization (2026-10-19)

Head `d39e83a31ae8530e3ac033da2d4f37ca2699dfc0` normally merges `main@1f033134` into the original PR branch. The conflicting test additions were combined, preserving the renewal regressions and upstream SSH capture/ACK coverage; no new production renewal behavior was added.

Independent Windows verification: **304/304** Hosted-turn tests and **11/11** renewal cases passed. Frozen installation and **2,097** supply-chain checks, workspace build/bundle, CLI typecheck, changed-file Prettier/ESLint, normal pre-commit hooks, and the compiled CLI `0.25.2` smoke passed.

The 17 additional consumer files initially reported **525 passed / 1 failed**: publisher P2-B returned HTTP 409 during concurrent writes. Its isolated retry passed **1/1**, and the complete publisher file passed **26/26**. All 69 runtime-reachable source modules for that test are identical to the fixed main baseline and do not load this PR's changed module. The initial failure is retained as an unresolved intermittent result, not called a first-run clean suite or a proven root cause; no unrelated publisher change was added. This is not a full-repository or live-service E2E claim.

The new head was pushed normally. Fresh CI and re-review are pending; the formal review aggregate remains CHANGES_REQUESTED.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: renewal eligibility must not erase the original binding needed by failure cleanup; the regression suite pins both paths. Review remains important for this Hosted lifecycle code.
- Not validated / out of scope: full npm run preflight did not complete. Its default 2 GiB integration-typecheck heap exhausted memory; a separate full typecheck passes with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096. The repository-wide unit-test run then encounters EPERM when browser-use tests bind Unix-domain sockets in this environment. The scoped Hosted suites reported above pass; no full-suite pass or real Java Broker, Session Store, database/OSS E2E is claimed. Tenant-wide reservation-expiry races remain outside this change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no protocol, server, ownership, or public-interface changes.
- AI assistance: implementation and tests were produced with OpenAI Codex. Technical self-audit is complete; ready for maintainer review.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12957. Follow-up to merged #12894.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

在原始执行被权威地确认 settled 后，停止续期对应的 Hosted Shell publication，同时保留其 binding 直到回执接纳完成，确保失败清理仍能工作。每轮续期都会尝试所有仍有效的 binding，然后携带 publication ID 报告失败。在观察到 settled 时已经发出的续期请求，即使随后失败也不会产生误导性告警；真实的续期失败仍会阻止派发。

## 为什么需要

Session 回执提交缓慢时，已 settled 的执行仍保留在批次的记录中。publication 服务按设计拒绝对已 settled 执行续期，但客户端此前仍持续请求续期并输出误导性告警。第一次拒绝还会阻断本轮后续排队 publication 的续期。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在包含两个 Shell 调用的批次中，让第一个执行保持运行并推进续期定时器。预期正在运行的第一个 publication 与排队中的第二个 publication 都得到续期。
2. 让第一个执行 settled，将回执提交阻塞两个定时器周期，并确认仅排队中的 publication 继续续期。释放回执后，两个调用都应完成、正常释放归属，且不出现 publication 续期告警。对通过原始 finished publication 恢复以及已证明未启动的执行重复验证。
3. 让一个已发出的续期请求在客户端观察到 settled 后才拒绝。预期不会告警，也不会阻止排队 publication 的续期。
4. 让尚未 settled 的 publication 在定时续期时返回 HTTP 503。该轮仍应续期排队的 publication，且只输出一条包含失败 publication ID 的告警。下一轮成功续期应再次尝试两个仍有效的 publication。派发前续期遇到 HTTP 400 或 503 时，仍必须在尝试所有 binding 后阻止派发。
5. 返回无 capture、派发前取消的执行结果，再拒绝 finished publication 查询。恢复路径必须取消原始执行，并使用原始 publication ID 和 token 发送 close_not_started，且不能释放尚不确定的归属。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

不适用可视化证据：这是内部 Hosted 生命周期行为，不涉及 TUI 布局变化。将最初的八项回归测试运行在未修改的基线 8eaaa1355cafbd0ae2716331b0eca57dec54b2e6 上，七项失败、清理行为保留测试通过。已 settled 的 publication 仍被续期，延迟回执产生误报告警并跳过排队 grant，而单个 binding 的真实错误也会终止本轮续期。相同的八项测试在应用修复后全部通过。修复后，581 项 Hosted CLI 测试（15 个文件）和 1,927 项 managed-runtime core 测试（34 个文件）全部通过，合计 2,508 项。完整 build、完整 typecheck（4 GiB Node 堆）、bundle、全仓 lint:ci、变更文件 Prettier 检查、diff 空白检查以及 serve-fast-path bundle 闭包检查均通过。

### 已测试的平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ head d39e83a31 的 304 项限定范围 Hosted-turn 测试（2026-10-19） |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 确定性组件测试 |

最新上游合并后的验证（2026-10-07，head b6ee9a1ac6a8）：Windows 上 210 项 Hosted-turn 测试、变更文件 Prettier/ESLint、CLI typecheck、完整 build/bundle 通过。上方较大规模的 Linux 测试数字属于初次修复验证，不代表在当前 head 重跑了全量套件。

Review 跟进（2026-10-11，head 91b3bf80a）：续期错误保留 binding 引用，整轮结束时再次按当前 settled 状态过滤。新增用例先拒绝第一条续期，再将第二条续期阻塞到第一条回执和 ACK 完成之后；仅在 catch 时过滤的旧实现会抛 HostedToolRecoveryRequiredError，修复后两个执行及 ACK 均完成，无取消或续期误告警。独立验证为 Hosted-turn 217/217、续期专项 9/9，含 HTTP 400/503 派发前 fail-closed 和清理用例；变更文件格式/lint、完整 workspace+integration 类型检查、CLI 重建、bundle 和编译后版本检查通过。全新 frozen-lockfile 安装因 registry 请求/外平台缓存 metadata 不可用而未完成，本次使用既有锁定版本依赖缓存；未声称真实远端服务 E2E 或全仓单元测试通过。重试策略及 store/client 完成观察滞后确认留作非阻塞后续，本次不根据 400 或消息文本判断 settled。

prs.title: fix(web-shell): preserve focus when trajectory execution views disappear
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps keyboard focus in the trajectory panel when the focused recent-executions list disappears or the selected execution is evicted. Focus returns to the surviving list or its expand button; a user already working in another control keeps their focus.

## Why it's needed

Resizing below the compact-height threshold, clearing execution records, or exceeding the retained execution limit could remove the focused element and leave focus on the document body. Keyboard navigation then lost its place.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Focus Recent executions and shrink the panel below 480px tall, or clear its execution records. Focus should move to the Recent executions toggle.
- Open execution details and add enough newer same-kind records to evict the selection. Focus should return to the recent list, or its toggle when collapsed. The evicted selection must remain cleared.
- Repeat these changes while another control has focus. That control must retain focus.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Controlled Chromium fixture using the actual React panel, lifecycle store and virtualizer, without a daemon or model. The observation badge reports the browser's actual activeElement; the blue outline makes focus visible. Before uses main at `0df419d898`; after uses this fix. Each pair uses the same viewport.

| Scenario | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Resize, 1440×450 | ![Before resize](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/4bd5fce76ff01b757375fe25aa2c597a6c074587/before-resize.png) | ![After resize](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/4bd5fce76ff01b757375fe25aa2c597a6c074587/after-resize.png) |
| Execution eviction, 1440×1000 | ![Before eviction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/4bd5fce76ff01b757375fe25aa2c597a6c074587/before-eviction.png) | ![After eviction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/4bd5fce76ff01b757375fe25aa2c597a6c074587/after-eviction.png) |

### Shadow DOM regression evidence

The two focus guards also resolve the active element from the removed element's own root, so portal Shadow DOM mode behaves like light DOM. Four Shadow DOM regression cases failed on `f3bd630093` and pass after this follow-up. Independent Chromium verification passed all 28 combinations: light/open-shadow × regular/StrictMode × seven focus scenarios. The following controlled component fixture uses an open ShadowRoot with StrictMode; badges report the actual deep active element. No full App/daemon/SSE validation is claimed.

| Scenario | Before (`f3bd630093`) | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Resize, 1440×450 | ![Shadow before resize](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/da69fb50e9cf687bff88bf921432693f996ae538/before-resize.png) | ![Shadow after resize](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/da69fb50e9cf687bff88bf921432693f996ae538/after-resize.png) |
| Eviction, 1440×1000 | ![Shadow before eviction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/da69fb50e9cf687bff88bf921432693f996ae538/before-eviction.png) | ![Shadow after eviction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/da69fb50e9cf687bff88bf921432693f996ae538/after-eviction.png) |

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 121 component tests, 35 artifact tests, and 28 independent Chromium scenarios passed |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment

Node 24.14.1, pnpm 11.24.0. Frozen-lockfile install, root build, root typecheck, root bundle, changed-file ESLint/Prettier and whitespace checks passed. Four regression scenarios failed before the fix and passed afterward; three companion cases verify focus is not stolen. Local results are separate from hosted CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: focus restoration during element removal; checks are limited to the removed element owning focus.
- Not validated / out of scope: full daemon/SSE transport, Safari/Firefox, and PR7B auto-follow behavior.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no protocol, history pagination or retention-limit changes.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #14071: [R1-13](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14071#discussion_r4277701294) and [R1-20](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14071#discussion_r4277701337).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动

近期执行列表消失或选中执行被淘汰时，将键盘焦点恢复到仍存在的列表或展开按钮；用户已在其他控件操作时保持其焦点。

## 原因

面板缩矮进入紧凑布局、记录清空或超过执行保留上限时，原先会删除持有焦点的元素，使焦点掉到页面 body，键盘导航失去位置。

## 验证步骤与证据

- 聚焦近期执行列表后将面板高度缩到480px以下，或清空执行记录，焦点应回到近期执行按钮。
- 打开执行详情，再加入足够多同类型新记录淘汰选中项，焦点应回到列表；列表折叠时应回到按钮。被淘汰选择保持清除。
- 当用户已聚焦其他控件时重复上述操作，其他控件应保持焦点。

上方截图来自受控Chromium fixture，使用真实React面板、生命周期store和虚拟列表，没有daemon或模型。观察标签展示浏览器实际activeElement，蓝色轮廓标出焦点。Before为main `0df419d898`，After为本修复；缩矮对比均为1440×450，淘汰对比均为1440×1000。

## Shadow DOM 补充验证

两个焦点判断还会从被移除元素所在的根节点读取activeElement，使portal Shadow DOM模式与普通DOM一致。新增4个Shadow DOM回归场景在`f3bd630093`失败、修复后通过。独立Chromium共28个组合全部通过：普通/开放Shadow DOM × 常规/StrictMode × 7个焦点场景。上方补充截图使用open ShadowRoot与StrictMode，标签反映实际深层焦点；缩矮对比均为1440×450，淘汰对比均为1440×1000。本轮仍为受控组件fixture，不代表完整App/daemon/SSE验证。

## 测试环境与结果

macOS、Node24.14.1、pnpm11.24.0：121项组件测试、35项产物测试、28项独立Chromium场景通过。冻结lockfile安装、全仓build/typecheck/bundle、修改文件ESLint/Prettier和空白检查通过。4个回归场景在修复前失败、修复后通过，另3个场景确认不抢焦点。Windows/Linux未本地验证；这些结果与远端CI分开记录。

## 风险与范围

主要风险为元素移除时的焦点恢复，因此仅在被移除区域持有焦点时处理。未验证完整daemon/SSE链路及Safari/Firefox；PR7B自动跟随不在本次范围。没有破坏性变更或迁移，不改协议、历史分页和保留上限。

关联：#14071 的R1-13与R1-20，链接见上。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): ship a configuration template in the reference distribution
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The reference distribution now ships a configuration template and loads it automatically once the operator creates it. The bundled launchers export `SPRING_CONFIG_ADDITIONAL_LOCATION` for `config/application.yml` at the distribution root when the variable is unset, leave an operator-supplied value in effect, and never add an option to the command's positional arguments. The template contains no active settings; it documents the Runtime credential key ring, the bracket-key rule, and the placeholder form that preserves environment-variable overrides for the active pair.

## Why it's needed

The archive previously carried no configuration file. The credential key ring is a map and cannot be supplied through `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_*` variables, because relaxed binding normalises map keys; rotating a key therefore required an external YAML plus a hand-written config-location argument. A deployment that relied on environment variables alone started with an empty ring and reported no error. Shipping the template and pinning its location removes that silent failure and the manual argument.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Extract the archive and confirm the example configuration is present. Run the server launcher without creating the real file; it must pass arguments to Java unchanged and leave the variable unset. Create `config/application.yml`, rerun, and confirm the launcher exports the config location for that file while still passing arguments unchanged. Set `SPRING_CONFIG_ADDITIONAL_LOCATION` and confirm the launcher does not override it. Run the operator-recovery launcher with `inspect <id> <generation>`; the subcommand and its arguments must reach Java unchanged while the variable is set. The packaging unit test covers all cases, including the recovery entry.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI change).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A (unit test).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a present configuration file is now loaded by default through the environment; environment variables still take precedence over its values, and the launcher never adds positional options.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows launchers; the reference archive targets Linux.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. A deployment without the file behaves exactly as before.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/managed-agent-distribution-config-template/docs/design/2026-10-14-managed-agent-reference-distribution.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/managed-agent-distribution-config-template/docs/design/2026-10-14-managed-agent-reference-distribution.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

N/A.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

参考分发现在自带配置模板，并在运维人员创建配置文件后自动加载。bundle 内的启动脚本在变量未设置时导出 `SPRING_CONFIG_ADDITIONAL_LOCATION=file:<分发产物根目录>/config/application.yml`，运维人员已设置的值保持生效，且不会向命令的位置参数注入任何选项。模板不含生效配置，只说明 Runtime 凭据密钥环、方括号写法，以及保留环境变量覆盖语义的占位符形式。

## 为什么需要

此前压缩包不含配置文件。凭据密钥环是映射结构，无法通过 `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_*` 环境变量提供，因为宽松绑定会规整映射键；轮换密钥因此需要外部 YAML 和手写的配置位置参数。只依赖环境变量的部署会以空 ring 启动且不报错。随包提供模板并固定加载位置，消除了这一静默失败和手工参数。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

解压产物并确认示例配置存在。未创建真实配置文件时运行 server 启动脚本，参数应原样传给 Java，变量应保持未设置。创建 `config/application.yml` 后重跑，确认启动脚本导出该文件的配置位置，且位置参数仍原样传递。设置 `SPRING_CONFIG_ADDITIONAL_LOCATION` 后确认启动脚本不覆盖。用 `inspect <id> <generation>` 运行 operator-recovery 启动脚本，确认子命令与参数原样到达 Java，同时变量已设置。打包单测覆盖上述全部情形，包括恢复入口。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A（非 UI 改动）。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

N/A（单元测试）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：存在配置文件时现在会通过环境变量默认加载；环境变量仍优先于文件值，且启动脚本不会注入位置选项。

- 破坏性变更／迁移说明：无。没有该文件的部署行为与之前完全一致。

auto_merge.commit_message:
* feat(managed-agent): ship a configuration template in the reference distribution

The reference archive carried no application.yml, so the Runtime credential
key ring — which cannot be expressed through QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_* variables
because relaxed binding normalises map keys — forced every rotating deployment
to create a file and pass --spring.config.additional-location by hand.

Ship config/application.example.yml and have both launchers load
config/application.yml from the bundle root when it exists, leaving an
operator-supplied SPRING_CONFIG_ADDITIONAL_LOCATION in effect.

* fix(managed-agent): pass the distribution config through the environment

The shared launcher injected --spring.config.additional-location before the
operator's arguments, so the operator-recovery entry, which dispatches on
args[0] and the exact argument count, could no longer run inspect, prepare or
complete.

Export SPRING_CONFIG_ADDITIONAL_LOCATION instead and leave the argument vector
untouched for both launchers. Also make the template's active key pair use the
mapped placeholders, so a copied example still honours the documented
environment override.

* test(managed-agent): isolate the launcher test from an ambient config variable

The test spread process.env, so a machine that already exported
SPRING_CONFIG_ADDITIONAL_LOCATION changed the launcher's behaviour and failed
the new assertions. Remove the variable from the base environment; the
explicit operator-override case still sets it.

prs.title: feat(channels): add WeCom application callback support
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a separate `wecom-callback` channel for text direct messages through a WeCom self-built application. It verifies and decrypts HTTP callbacks, passes accepted messages through the existing access/session/agent flow, and sends replies using the application API. The channel is configurable through the CLI and Web Shell, including masked credentials and environment references.

## Why it's needed

The existing WeCom channel connects intelligent robots using Bot ID and Secret over WebSocket. Enterprises using self-built applications instead need Corp ID, Agent ID, application Secret, callback Token and EncodingAESKey, plus an HTTP callback endpoint. Those applications currently cannot connect.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Configure a self-built application channel and start it behind a public HTTPS callback URL. Saving that URL in WeCom should complete its encrypted verification challenge.
2. Send a text message from an allowed application member. Expect one agent task and a reply from the application. Retry the same callback and send from a visible member outside the allowlist; neither should start another task.
3. Request a long reply containing Chinese text and emoji. Expect the complete response in ordered messages within the 2048-byte limit, addressed only to the original user.
4. Stop the channel and confirm its callback port is released. Existing intelligent-robot configurations should continue working.
5. Without enterprise credentials, run the committed callback protocol/adapter tests and existing WeCom regression tests. They use an independent published SDK crypto fixture, real loopback HTTP requests and mocked application API responses.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the global Qwen CLI 0.22.0 rejects the isolated configuration with `Channel type "wecom-callback" is not supported`.

After: the locally built CLI resolves all five credential environment references and completes a real callback → ChannelBase → session routing → ACP → local mock model → application reply flow. The callback returns before the held model response completes. There is exactly one model request, two complete UTF-8-safe reply chunks and one token request; duplicate, denied and invalid-signature callbacks create no extra task. SIGTERM releases the port. This is offline execution evidence, not real-tenant acceptance.

Current follow-up validation passes build, typecheck, bundle, changed-file ESLint, Prettier and diff checks. The focused suites pass 241 tests: 193 WeCom (including 142 existing robot regressions), 46 CLI registry and 2 Web Shell platform tests. Independent verification on Node 22 passed all 193 WeCom tests and the offline built-CLI flow. Two clean self-audit passes and an independent complete-diff review found no actionable findings; this is local validation, not a formal GitHub approval.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Offline tests and built CLI |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node 26.7.0, pinned pnpm 11.24.0. CLI E2E uses isolated configuration/runtime/workspace directories, a local model server and test-only interception of the fixed WeCom API. No live enterprise messages were sent.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: callbacks are acknowledged before agent completion; the retry cache is process-local, so a restart can lose acknowledged in-flight work. The HTTP listener belongs to its channel worker and defaults to loopback.
- Not validated / out of scope: real WeCom URL registration, app visibility and trusted outbound IPs remain untested and require tenant acceptance. This first version supports text private messages; groups, media, application events, streaming, durable delivery and multiple apps on one listener are outside scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no migration for existing `wecom` robot configurations; self-built applications use the new channel type and separate credentials.

The complete [English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/wecom-callback/docs/design/wecom-callback.md) and [Chinese design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/wecom-callback/docs/design/wecom-callback.zh-CN.md) are synchronized, including decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria and deferred durable delivery.

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): load saved tool details on expansion
prs.body:
## What this PR does

ReadFile and Shell cards load saved arguments, output and errors when a reader expands an individual settled card. Lifecycle updates carry metadata, so tool completion and transcript refresh no longer scan preceding history or publish detail text inline. Closing a card cancels its request; switching Sessions discards stale responses, and a later saved result refreshes an already opened card.

Detail reads are enabled by default, require a trusted actor with current Session/Workspace read access, and can be disabled by an administrator. Existing retained results work without backfilling public events or enabling Artifact publication. The API contract advances to 1.67.0. Missing output, recorded empty output and truncated output remain distinguishable. Shell cards no longer show an empty execution-details section, and loaded ReadFile paths remain available for file preview.

## Why it's needed

Managed history saved ReadFile diagnostics and Shell results but exposed only lifecycle summaries to the cards. Failed reads expanded without the saved error, while completed commands displayed unavailable output. Extracting every result eagerly adds history reads to the execution feed even when nobody opens the card.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Refresh a Managed conversation containing saved failed ReadFile and completed Shell calls. No detail request should occur until an individual card opens; opening a multi-tool summary alone should make no detail request.
- Expand each card. Expect its own saved diagnostic, command and output. An explicitly saved empty result should say “No output”; missing history should say unavailable. Open a ReadFile preview after its path loads.
- Close a card during a pending read, reopen it, and switch Sessions. Expect cancellation, a fresh read on reopening, and no stale Session content. A result arriving after its completion receipt should refresh an open card.
- Remove Workspace read access or disable detail reads. Expect no private details. Confirm no prompt, command or Runtime is started by expanding a card.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the clean original PR performed a preceding-history lookup over `[1, 10000]` and emitted saved arguments/output before any card opened. After: the same producer reproduction makes no preceding-history lookup and emits metadata only. Six isolated Chromium cases verify zero requests on refresh/group expansion, per-card reads, saved errors/output, empty/missing output, cancellation and reopening, with zero prompt submissions.

Local validation: root build, typecheck and bundle passed; final affected WebShell rebuild passed; 453 consumer/component tests, 36 packaged-artifact tests and 9 producer tests passed. Focused Java/API verification passed with 96 tests (one profile-conditional skip), Checkstyle and SpotBugs; all 24 disposable MySQL 8.4 integration tests passed. Full Maven verification completed 4,683 tests with no failures/errors and 18 profile/platform skips; Checkstyle and SpotBugs passed. The subsequent contract-version metadata update also passed API/surface verification (22 tests, one profile-conditional skip) and the version-advance guard.

The readonly transcript measures 1,340,018 UTF-16 units; its measured ceiling is 1,341,000. A separate regression confirms the detail HTTP transport stays outside that entry.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| macOS | ✅ Local build, unit/API, MySQL 8.4 and Chromium |
| Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment

Node 22, JDK 21, Maven 3.9, disposable MySQL 8.4 and an isolated browser fixture server. The original Managed Session, database and running service were not modified. Browser checks cover the UI/API boundary; they do not establish a deployed Hosted execution environment.

## Risk & Scope

- Authorized Session/Workspace readers can read bounded saved text by default. Administrators may set `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_TOOL_DETAILS_ENABLED=false`; Artifact publication and original-download policies stay independent.
- The first expansion adds one HTTP round trip and a bounded persisted-history read: at most 512 transactions/8 MiB, with allowlisted input capped at 4 KiB and output at 8 KiB/200 lines. Pruned or over-budget history remains unavailable.
- No schema migration or public-history backfill. Live output, media and raw capture downloads are outside this change. Disabling new reads does not erase previously published inline data.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-tool-details/docs/design/2026-10-19-managed-inline-tool-details.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-tool-details/docs/design/2026-10-19-managed-inline-tool-details.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

用户展开单个已结束的 ReadFile 或 Shell 卡片时，才读取已保存的参数、输出和错误。生命周期更新只携带元数据，因此工具完成和刷新会话不再回扫在先历史或内联发布详情。关闭卡片会取消请求，切换 Session 会丢弃过期响应；保存结果晚到时，已展开的卡片会刷新。

详情读取默认启用，要求可信 actor 和当前 Session/Workspace 读取权限，管理员可关闭。保留的旧结果无需回填公共事件或启用 Artifact 发布即可读取。API 契约版本升至 1.67.0。缺失、显式空输出和截断输出保持可区分。Shell 卡片不再显示空的执行详情区域，异步加载的 ReadFile 路径仍可用于文件预览。

## 为什么需要

Managed 历史已保存 ReadFile 诊断和 Shell 结果，但卡片只能取得生命周期摘要。因此失败读取展开后没有已保存的错误，完成的命令显示输出不可用。提前提取每个结果会向执行事件流加入历史读取，即使无人展开卡片。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 刷新包含已保存失败 ReadFile 和完成 Shell 调用的 Managed 会话。展开单个卡片前不应出现详情请求；仅展开多工具摘要也不应查询详情。
- 分别展开卡片，应显示各自保存的诊断、命令和输出。显式保存的空结果应显示“No output”，历史缺失应显示不可用。路径加载后可打开 ReadFile 文件预览。
- 请求未完成时关闭卡片，然后重开并切换 Session。应取消旧请求，重开时重新查询，且不显示其他 Session 的过期内容。结束回执之后才到达的结果应刷新已展开卡片。
- 撤销 Workspace 读取权限或关闭详情读取，应不再返回私有详情。展开卡片不应提交提示、执行命令或启动 Runtime。

### 修复前后证据

修复前：原 PR 干净版本在任何卡片展开之前，就查询 `[1, 10000]` 在先历史并发送已保存的参数和输出。修复后：相同生产者复现没有在先历史查询，只发送元数据。六项隔离 Chromium 测试验证刷新和组展开时零请求、逐卡查询、保存的错误和输出、空与缺失输出、取消与重开，且提示提交次数为零。

本地验证：根目录 build、typecheck 和 bundle 通过；最终受影响 WebShell 重建通过；453 项消费端/组件测试、36 项打包产物测试及 9 项生产者测试通过。定向 Java/API 验证的 96 项测试通过（一项依赖专用 profile 的测试跳过），Checkstyle 和 SpotBugs 通过；24 项可销毁 MySQL 8.4 集成测试全部通过。完整 Maven 验证完成 4,683 项测试，零失败、零错误，18 项依赖 profile/平台的测试跳过；Checkstyle 和 SpotBugs 通过。之后的契约版本元数据更新也通过 API/路由契约验证（22 项测试，一项依赖专用 profile 的测试跳过）及版本递增检查。

只读 transcript 实测为 1,340,018 个 UTF-16 单元，按实测设置上限为 1,341,000。独立回归还验证详情 HTTP 传输代码不会进入该入口。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--- | :--- |
| macOS | ✅ 本地构建、单元/API、MySQL 8.4 和 Chromium |
| Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境

Node 22、JDK 21、Maven 3.9、可销毁 MySQL 8.4 和隔离浏览器夹具服务。未修改原 Managed Session、数据库及正在运行的服务。浏览器验证覆盖 UI/API 边界，不代表已部署 Hosted 执行环境验收。

## 风险与范围

- 获准读取 Session/Workspace 的用户默认可以读取有界保存文本。管理员可设置 `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_TOOL_DETAILS_ENABLED=false`；Artifact 发布与原始下载策略保持独立。
- 首次展开增加一次 HTTP 往返和有界持久化历史读取：最多 512 个事务/8 MiB，白名单输入最多 4 KiB，输出最多 8 KiB/200 行。已裁剪或超过预算的历史仍显示不可用。
- 无数据库迁移或公共历史回填。实时输出、媒体及原始捕获下载不属于本次修改。关闭新读取不会擦除先前发布的内联数据。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-tool-details/docs/design/2026-10-19-managed-inline-tool-details.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-tool-details/docs/design/2026-10-19-managed-inline-tool-details.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整且同步。

## 关联 Issue

无。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): bound publication placement waits
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Bounds the first tenant-placement wait shared by native publication entries, including dispatch, producer completion, claim and verification. It reuses the existing statement budget and store-level contention error while preserving the transaction connection, lock order, grant checks and CSI behavior.

Draft: whole-module and CI acceptance are still pending.

## Why it's needed

These requests could wait at an unlimited placement acquisition before reaching the later bounded publication guard. With a valid reserved publication, the real MySQL store entry waited 50,210 ms before an unnamed lock-timeout exception. Bounding the later guard could not shorten that first wait.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Reserve a valid native publication, then hold its tenant placement row in another transaction. Dispatch verification and producer completion should fail within the existing contention ceiling with an in-process 503 `tenant_guard_contended` exception, without changing the grant, operation or resource records.
- Release the holder and retry the same grant. Dispatch and finish should succeed, with the producer reaching `FINISHED`.
- Confirm placement still precedes the binding/execution locks on the original transaction connection. The bound is per acquisition statement, not an overall five-second request deadline.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Store-entry scenario | Observation |
| --- | --- |
| Before: valid dispatch with placement held | 50,210 ms; unnamed MySQL 1205 / SQLState 40001 |
| After: dispatch with placement held | 5,117 ms; in-process 503 `tenant_guard_contended` |
| After: producer completion with placement held | 5,175 ms; in-process 503 `tenant_guard_contended` |
| After releasing the holder | Same grant dispatches and finishes; producer phase `FINISHED` |

Rejected calls preserved the grant/operation/resource snapshots, and observed SQL used the original transaction connection. The exact candidate production class was compiled remotely and its loaded identity was checked during the real MySQL run. The retained regression source also compiled remotely. Its selected MySQL JUnit method then ran from the precompiled candidate: discovery 1, started 1, successful 1, exit 0 (34.9 seconds); the added dispatch/finish failure and release/retry assertions passed. These are component-level observations, with no browser screenshots or full Hosted acceptance claim.

The native high-effort review completed all 13 static roles and two dry reverse audits: **0 Critical, 4 Suggestions, 2 Nice-to-have**. Its composed result is `COMMENT`, capped by the unexecuted build/test dimension, so it is **not clean-certified**. The user's prohibition on local builds takes precedence over that workflow's forced install/build step; this Draft preserves the gap for CI rather than claiming it passed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ existing remote JDK compilation only |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ real MySQL store probe; full module unverified |

### Environment (optional)

Linux/aarch64, Temurin JRE 21.0.12.1+1 and disposable MySQL 8.4.11; the database's default 50-second lock timeout was unchanged. The precompiled reference source is `39c237af3b9dd994b502e82809652f7bcf086f46`; ten directly relevant production blobs match the task base `c6018c63b53ed8bfb96a3048dfebcd541d4f682d`. The exact candidate class and probe ran as precompiled bytecode. No local build, compiler or dependency installation was used; the probe and JUnit containers were cleaned up.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a contended first placement acquisition refuses earlier. The raw broker HTTP adapter currently flattens this store exception to 500 `runtime_broker_internal_error`, and its v3 client has no code-specific contention retry. This PR does not claim a 503 wire response or repair that separate adapter/client behavior.
- Not validated / out of scope: full Maven, Checkstyle/SpotBugs, the complete mysql-integration profile, HTTP/CLI/WebShell/CSI and the Hosted fault matrix. The separate A.2/A.3 retention and lifecycle gaps remain open. Nonblocking native-review suggestions are disclosed in the review follow-up comment.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no schema, public API, configuration or persistent-format change.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/84e6dbee12d393e99b2487b0a9b8201a98a527cc/docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-tenant-guard-wedge.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/84e6dbee12d393e99b2487b0a9b8201a98a527cc/docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-tenant-guard-wedge.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Addresses A.1 of the multi-item tracker; does not close the whole issue.

Refs #14393
Refs #12380

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

为原生 publication 共用入口的首次 tenant placement 等待增加上界，覆盖 dispatch、producer 完成、claim 和验证。复用现有逐语句预算与 store 层争用错误，保留原事务连接、锁顺序、grant 检查及 CSI 行为。

当前为 Draft：整模块及 CI 验收仍未完成。

## 为什么需要

这些请求在进入后续有界 publication guard 之前，会先等待一个无超时的 placement 获取。真实 MySQL store 使用有效已预留 publication 时，修复前等待50,210毫秒才抛出未命名锁超时；后面的 guard 有界也无法缩短这次等待。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 预留有效 publication，再用独立事务持有同 tenant 的 placement 行。dispatch 校验与 producer 完成应在既有争用见证上限内抛出进程内503 `tenant_guard_contended`，grant、operation、resource 记录保持不变。
- 释放锁后重试同一 grant，dispatch 和 finish 应成功，producer 到达 `FINISHED`。
- 确认 placement 仍在原事务连接上先于 binding/execution 加锁。上界按每次获取锁的语句计算，不承诺整个请求在五秒内完成。

### 修复前后证据

| Store入口场景 | 观察结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 修复前：持有placement时执行有效dispatch | 50,210毫秒；未命名MySQL1205 / SQLState40001 |
| 修复后：持有placement时执行dispatch | 5,117毫秒；进程内503 `tenant_guard_contended` |
| 修复后：持有placement时完成producer | 5,175毫秒；进程内503 `tenant_guard_contended` |
| 释放持锁事务后 | 同一grant成功dispatch并完成，producer为`FINISHED` |

拒绝前后的grant、operation、resource快照一致，SQL观察确认复用原事务连接。精确候选生产类在远端窄编译，真实MySQL运行核对了实际加载的class身份。保留的回归测试源码也已远端编译；随后运行精确候选的预编译MySQL JUnit方法，发现1项、启动1项、成功1项，退出0，耗时34.9秒，新增dispatch/finish拒绝及释放后重试断言均通过。这些都是组件级证据，没有浏览器截图或完整Hosted验收声明。

原生高强度审查完成13个静态维度和两轮无新发现的反向审查：0个Critical、4个Suggestion、2个Nice-to-have。原生组合结论为`COMMENT`，因未执行构建/测试维度而被限制，不能宣称clean。用户禁止本地build的要求优先于该流程强制安装/构建的步骤，因此先发Draft，把该缺口交给CI继续验证，不把未执行的检查算通过。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |

Linux/aarch64、Temurin JRE21.0.12.1+1、隔离MySQL8.4.11，数据库默认50秒锁等待保持不变。预编译reference源码为`39c237af3b9dd994b502e82809652f7bcf086f46`，十个直接相关生产blob与任务基线`c6018c63b53ed8bfb96a3048dfebcd541d4f682d`相同。候选类和probe均运行预编译字节码，没有本地build、编译或安装依赖，探针及JUnit容器均已清理。

prs.title: fix(rewind): resolve legacy turns by source identity
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Conversation rewind links visible messages, model entries and recorded boundaries through source identity, or refuses before mutation. A recovered legacy conversation key cannot authorize file restore. Retry, resume and JSON history rollback preserve that identity.

A turn starts at its prompt entry. A tool-lap continuation carries the same id because it belongs to that turn, but it is not a second candidate: the resolver treats only the prompt entry as the turn's anchor. The Ink selector lists only turns that carry an identity, so a listed turn always has something to resolve.

The daemon checkpoint catalog and rewind notification still carry the existing admitted prompt identity, but resolving it in Web Shell, VS Code and the SDK is a separate change — no daemon-backed client behavior changes here.

## Why it's needed

Legacy placeholder-shaped prompts could disappear visibly while remaining in model context. Retry snapshots and invisible ordinary turns could also shift a recorded cut.

Two failures came out of the identity work and are fixed here:

- A turn cancelled between tool-loop laps pushed its continuation into model history stamped with the turn's own id. The unique-match resolver counted both marks, so every such cancellation became a permanent refusal — unrewindable, uneditable, untakeable, silently.
- Turns without any identity (an accepted-speculation turn, a persisted custom slash invocation) were offered as rewind targets and refused after the fact, with a message blaming a retry that never happened.

This follows #9437; #9466 and #13729 are merged separately.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Resume `hello`, `[Old inline media cleared: image/png]`, `world` and their replies. Rewind the second prompt: visible, next-request and cold-restored histories should retain only `hello` and its reply. Recovered keys must not restore files.
- Fail A, retry it successfully, then submit B. Edit B and resend: A remains, old B/reply disappear and edited B appears once.
- In an ACP session, cancel a turn between tool laps, then rewind to that turn from the list and edit it. The turn must resolve; the continuation entry must not act as a second anchor.
- Resume a session whose custom slash invocation was sent to the model. The invocation row must not appear in the Ink rewind list; identified turns around it must still be selectable.
- Check a retained target after a compressed prefix and a JSON history echo. Unique source associations must still resolve; missing or duplicated associations must refuse without selecting a different turn. Rewind metadata must not reach the model.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The earlier real-producer and Ink/tmux reports ([`#issuecomment-6139059338`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13737#issuecomment-6139059338), [`#issuecomment-6077085058`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13737#issuecomment-6077085058)) are revision-pinned to heads that still contained the daemon/Web Shell surface; that surface is no longer part of this change, so they are historical evidence, not evidence about this head.

For this narrowed head the two new defects have focused source regressions:

- `packages/core/src/services/session-api-history.test.ts` — the prompt entry resolves when its continuation repeats the id; two prompt entries sharing one id still refuse.
- `packages/cli/src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts` — `getRewindCutPoint` resolves a cancelled turn whose tool-lap continuation repeats its mark, and a pre-send cancel keeps a continued turn's stripped identity instead of the previous turn's mark.
- `packages/cli/src/ui/utils/historyMapping.test.ts` and `RewindSelector.test.tsx` — an identity-less real-user row is not a rewind target; `AppContainer` does not open an empty selector.

Local runs on macOS: core `session-api-history` 53/53, CLI `Session.test.ts` 1263/1263, `historyMapping` 33/33, the new selector case in isolation. Each new regression was mutation-checked: it fails when its fix is reverted. `AppContainer.test.tsx` cannot run in this local jsdom setup (test-setup fails with `tmpdir is not a function`, reproduced at the base commit); the same environment also fails ten pre-existing `React.act` cases in `RewindSelector.test.tsx`. CI is the gate for both.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ build, typecheck, focused unit suites above |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22, root build and typecheck, focused vitest suites. No full test suite and no UI run for this head.

## Risk & Scope

- Compatibility stays deliberately fail-closed: unassociated legacy ACP histories and persisted custom slash/skill rows may refuse conversation rewind. Legacy numeric rewind notifications retain their old interpretation for older senders.
- The resolver change is the same exclusion the deleted positional walk applied: a `functionResponse` continuation is not a prompt entry. The continuation mark itself is kept — it records turn membership and keeps the entry attributable — so transport-id and history-echo paths are unchanged.
- `29 files, +1775/-986` (implementation, regression tests and the two existing bilingual designs).
- The daemon association (`daemonPromptId` on the catalog and `session_rewound`) is carried on the wire only; no Web Shell, VS Code or SDK consumer is changed here.
- Remaining Suggestions from earlier rounds stay in #13869; #13794 remains separate maintenance.
- Not validated: Windows/Linux, native model-driven compression, the daemon-backed clients (out of scope), every slash-entry timing, changed-file byte restoration and the full native CI-review engine.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-9437-rewind-contract-20261009/docs/design/rewind-stable-prompt-identity.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-9437-rewind-contract-20261009/docs/design/rewind-stable-prompt-identity.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Refs #9437. No issue is auto-closed.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

对话回退通过来源身份关联可见消息、模型条目和录制边界，无法关联则在变更前拒绝。恢复出的旧对话 key 不能授权文件恢复。重试、恢复和 JSON 历史回滚保留该身份。

轮次从它的 prompt 条目开始。工具循环的续跑条目因为属于该轮也会带同一个 id，但它不是第二个候选：解析器只把 prompt 条目当作该轮的锚点。Ink 选择器只列出带身份的轮次，因此列出来的目标一定可解析。

Daemon 检查点列表与回退通知仍携带既有的准入 prompt 身份，但在 Web Shell、VS Code 与 SDK 中解析它是另一项改动——本次不改变任何 daemon 界面的客户端行为。

## 为什么需要

旧占位符形状 prompt 可能从可见历史消失，却仍在模型上下文。重试快照和不可见普通轮次也可能使录制截断错位。

本次修复两个由身份改造暴露的问题：

- 在工具轮之间取消的轮次，会把续跑条目带着本轮 id 推进模型历史；唯一匹配解析器把两条都算上，于是每次这样的取消都变成永久拒绝——不可回退、不可编辑、不可撤回，且没有提示。
- 完全没有身份的轮次（接受的 speculation、持久化的自定义 slash 调用）被列为可回退目标，选中后才失败，还报告一次从未发生的重试。

## 验证

- 恢复 `hello`、`[Old inline media cleared: image/png]`、`world` 及各自回答，回退第二轮：可见、下一请求和冷恢复历史应只保留 `hello` 及回答；恢复 key 不得恢复文件。
- 让 A 失败，重试成功，再提交 B；编辑 B 重发：A 保留，旧 B/回答消失，编辑后的 B 只出现一次。
- ACP 会话中在工具轮之间取消一轮，再从列表回退并编辑该轮：必须能解析，续跑条目不得成为第二个锚点。
- 恢复一个自定义 slash 调用已发送给模型的会话：该调用行不得出现在 Ink 回退列表，周围带身份的轮次仍可选。
- 压缩前缀之后的保留目标、JSON 历史回传：唯一来源关联仍可解析；缺失或重复关联必须拒绝，且不得改选另一轮。回退元数据不得进入模型请求。

较早的真实链路与 Ink/tmux 报告绑定在仍包含 daemon/Web Shell 面的旧 head 上，该面已不在本次改动范围内，因此只作为历史证据。本次收窄 head 的两个新缺陷由上面的定向源码回归覆盖；本机 macOS 运行结果见英文小节，`AppContainer.test.tsx` 的本地 jsdom 环境问题在 base 上同样存在，以 CI 为准。

## 风险与范围

- 兼容边界仍是失败关闭：无关联的旧 ACP 历史、持久化自定义 slash/skill 调用行可能拒绝对话回退。旧数字通知仍按原语义兼容旧发送方。
- 解析器改动与被删除的位置式遍历使用同一条排除规则：带 `functionResponse` 的续跑条目不是 prompt 条目。续跑条目的标记本身保留（它记录轮次归属，条目仍可归属），因此传输 id 与历史回传路径不变。
- 文件数与本 PR 的 diff 一致；实现、回归测试与两份既有双语设计同属本次改动。
- daemon 关联（检查点列表与 `session_rewound` 上的 `daemonPromptId`）本次只上线线上字段；不改变 Web Shell、VS Code 与 SDK 的消费者。
- 其余 Suggestions 保留在 #13869；#13794 仍是独立维护事项。
- 未验证：Windows/Linux、自然模型压缩、daemon 界面客户端（不在范围内）、全部 slash 时序、变更文件字节恢复和完整原生 CI-review 引擎。

</details>

prs.title: fix(serve): contain Hosted stdio MCP servers in a process group (#14503)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

On POSIX, every Hosted stdio MCP server is now launched through a small supervisor that owns the transport's stdin and starts the real command in its own process group. The launcher forwards stdin to the server; when that stdin closes, a graceful release or a worker SIGKILL, it ends the server's stdin, waits one second, sends SIGTERM to the whole group, waits 300 ms, sends SIGKILL, and exits. A 100 ms parent-process check reaps when the worker disappears even while the stdin pipe is paused for backpressure. The transport still sees ordinary pipes, so MCP traffic, environment, cwd and exit handling are unchanged. On Windows the runtime keeps the SDK's original transport, so cross-spawn still resolves `.cmd`/`.bat` command shims; containment there is unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Issue #14503, found by the FG12 round (#14447), records that a Hosted stdio MCP server was a direct child of the Runtime worker and shared its process group. The reproduction at `main` `79362c2ecc` showed four leaks with the real runtime: a worker SIGKILL left an EOF-ignoring server alive, reparented to PID 1, in the Workspace and holding its manifest token; a graceful release left server-spawned descendants alive while reporting `released: true`; a descendant holding stdout turned the close into `managed_mcp_drain_unknown` at 5 s; and a forking wrapper died while its inner server survived. A process group gives the tree a handle, and the launcher makes a dead worker's stdin close the trigger.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the supervisor tests and the existing MCP runtime suite from `packages/cli`; both should be green. Then reproduce the two observable outcomes with a real runtime: a worker SIGKILL while an EOF-ignoring server is connected, and a graceful release while the server has spawned a descendant. In both cases no server or descendant should survive, and the release should settle inside the 5 s drain race.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The test engineer reran the original reproduction harness on the patched source twice:

| Case | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| worker SIGKILL, server ignores EOF | server alive (PPid 1, token in env) | gone within 3 s |
| graceful close, server-spawned descendant | descendant alive | gone; `released` in about 1.4 s |
| descendant holds stdout | `managed_mcp_drain_unknown` at 5 s, descendant alive | `released` in about 1.45 s, descendant gone |
| forking wrapper | inner server alive, `managed_mcp_drain_unknown` | inner server gone, `released` in about 1.44 s |

```text
managed-stdio-supervisor.test.ts: 3/3
managed-mcp-runtime.test.ts: 37/37
packages/cli tsc --noEmit: 0 errors
eslint + prettier: clean
```

The saturated-pipe case was added for the review finding: the holder writes 2 MB to a server that never reads and then SIGKILLs itself; the launcher, server and descendant are reaped. The same test failed on the previous launcher (no settle after 10 s) and passes now.

The harness's own summary line reports `pass=5 fail=1` because its SIGKILL branch counted the old surviving-server behavior as a pass; the per-case process checks above are the evidence.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 26.5.1, Node 22.22.2, the real `ManagedMcpRuntime` imported through `tsx`; no JDK and no MySQL were needed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this is the process-group fallback the issue allows, not a cgroup unit. A descendant that calls `setsid` escapes the group. The launcher bounds the worker-death orphan window to about 1.5 s, but the Broker's stopped-worker close still treats the absent worker PID as proof; a cgroup unit plus a Broker-visible emptiness proof is the follow-up.
- Not validated / out of scope: no cgroup integration, no Java/Broker change, the Windows path keeps the SDK transport and was not executed, and a process-group id can be reused in principle. The full `npm run build` is blocked locally by an unrelated `web-shell` missing `shiki-files/wasm`; rebuilding core alone made the CLI typecheck clean.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The launcher is transparent to the server's env, cwd, stdin/stdout protocol and exit handling, and needs no delegated root.

Design documents: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/14503-mcp-stdio-containment/docs/design/2026-10-19-mcp-stdio-containment.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/14503-mcp-stdio-containment/docs/design/2026-10-19-mcp-stdio-containment.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #14503. The remaining cgroup and Broker-proof items stay open as follow-ups.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 POSIX 上，每个 Hosted stdio MCP server 现在都经一个小型 supervisor 启动：它持有 transport 的 stdin，并把真实命令放进独立进程组。launcher 把 stdin 转发给 server；stdin 关闭时（优雅 release 或 worker SIGKILL），它关闭 server stdin、等 1 s、向整组发 SIGTERM、等 300 ms、再发 SIGKILL，然后退出。每 100 ms 检查父进程，worker 消失时即使 stdin 管道因背压暂停也能回收。transport 看到的仍是普通管道，因此 MCP 流量、环境、cwd 与退出处理不变。Windows 上 runtime 保留 SDK 原始 transport，cross-spawn 仍能解析 `.cmd`/`.bat` 命令 shim；那里的收容行为不变。

## 为什么需要

Issue #14503（由 FG12 轮次 #14447 发现）记录了 Hosted stdio MCP server 是 Runtime worker 的直接子进程、与 worker 共享进程组。在 `main` `79362c2ecc` 上用真实 runtime 复现出四类泄漏：worker SIGKILL 后忽略 EOF 的 server 仍存活、被 PID 1 收养、仍在 Workspace 内并持有 manifest token；优雅 release 报告 `released: true` 的同时留下 server 派生的后代；后代持有 stdout 使关闭在 5 s 变成 `managed_mcp_drain_unknown`；forking wrapper 退出后内层 server 存活。进程组给进程树一个可信号的手柄，launcher 让 worker 死亡的 stdin 关闭成为回收触发。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在 `packages/cli` 下运行 supervisor 测试与既有 MCP runtime 套件，两者应全绿。然后用真实 runtime 复现两个可观察结果：在忽略 EOF 的 server 连接时 SIGKILL worker；在 server 已派生后代时执行优雅 release。两种情形都不应有 server 或后代存活，release 应在 5 s drain 赛跑内收敛。

### 证据（前后对照）

test-engineer 在修补后的源码上用原复现装置跑了两遍：

| 用例 | 修复前 | 修复后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| worker SIGKILL，server 忽略 EOF | server 存活（PPid 1，环境中有 token） | 3 s 内消失 |
| 优雅关闭，server 派生后代 | 后代存活 | 消失；`released` 约 1.4 s |
| 后代持有 stdout | 5 s 报 `managed_mcp_drain_unknown`，后代存活 | 约 1.45 s `released`，后代消失 |
| forking wrapper | 内层 server 存活，`managed_mcp_drain_unknown` | 内层 server 消失，约 1.44 s `released` |

```text
managed-stdio-supervisor.test.ts: 3/3
managed-mcp-runtime.test.ts: 37/37
packages/cli tsc --noEmit: 0 errors
eslint + prettier: clean
```

背压用例是为评审发现新增的：持有者向从不读取的 server 写入 2 MB 后 SIGKILL 自己；launcher、server 与后代都被回收。同一用例在旧 launcher 上失败（10 s 未收敛），现在通过。

复现装置末行 `pass=5 fail=1` 是因为它的 SIGKILL 分支按修复前「server 存活才算 pass」编写；以上逐用例进程事实才是证据。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS 26.5.1、Node 22.22.2，经 `tsx` 引入真实 `ManagedMcpRuntime`；不需要 JDK 或 MySQL。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：本 PR 采用 issue 允许的进程组回退，不是 cgroup 单元。调用 `setsid` 的后代会逃出进程组。launcher 把 worker 死亡后的孤儿窗口压到约 1.5 s，但 Broker 的 stopped-worker close 仍把 worker PID 消失当作证明；cgroup 单元加 Broker 可见的空证明属于后续。
- 未验证 / 范围外：没有 cgroup 集成，没有 Java/Broker 改动，Windows 保留 SDK transport 且未执行，进程组 id 原则上可被复用。全仓 `npm run build` 在本机被无关的 `web-shell` 缺 `shiki-files/wasm` 挡住；单独重建 core 后 CLI 类型检查为 0。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。launcher 对 server 的环境、cwd、stdin/stdout 协议与退出处理透明，且不需要委派 root。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/14503-mcp-stdio-containment/docs/design/2026-10-19-mcp-stdio-containment.md) 与 [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/14503-mcp-stdio-containment/docs/design/2026-10-19-mcp-stdio-containment.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 issue

Refs #14503。剩余的 cgroup 与 Broker 证明项作为 follow-up 保持开放。

</details>

prs.title: test(cli): give turn-settling waits the slow-host budget
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The hosted-harness suite synchronises every simulated turn by polling the daemon until the pipeline reaches a terminal state. 245 of those waits carried a fixed 10 s budget. On a loaded CI host the pipeline outlasts that budget, so the suite fails on whichever assertion happens to be waiting — a different test on different days — while the turn is still doing legitimate work.

This routes those waits through the slow-host policy the file already applies in three places (`isSlowTestHost()`, 30 s), with a 45 s ceiling that stays under the 60 s per-test timeout the suite already sets on ECS hosts. No production code changes.

## Why it's needed

The same file has been failing on `main` and on PRs all day, always on a settlement wait, never on the logic under test:

| Where | Test that failed | Assertion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| #14542 `Test (ubuntu)`, `af854fe0` | `Hosted Harness stored definitions > loads published Skills from the saved resource after detach…` | `expect(status.body.hasActivePrompt).toBe(false)` — inside a `vi.waitFor({ timeout: 10_000 })` |
| `main` `e584d4d` | `… > pins the /2 file profile through create and load and advertises glob` | same shape |
| #14522 `Test (ubuntu)` | `… > settles a saved final native plan without new inference (expired/cancelled)` | same shape |
| auto-filed | #14406, #14023 | same file, same class |

Two details say "slow, not stuck": the teardown of the failing test also reported `ENOTEMPTY: directory not empty, rmdir …/managed-turn-result` — files were still being written when the test ended — and all three retries in the #14542 run failed the same way inside a window when that runner was carrying several other jobs.

## Evidence (Before & After)

Isolated, on an idle machine, both versions pass — so the change cannot be validated by a green local run alone; the point is the budget, not the output:

- whole file before the change: **593 passed**, 529.57 s
- whole file after the change: **593 passed**
- the previously failing test alone: 583 ms

The numbers that matter are the CI ones above: every failure is a 10 s poll expiring, and none of them is an assertion about behaviour.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: on a loaded host where the per-test ceiling is 15 s (GitHub-hosted `ubuntu-latest`, or the `env -i` verification child — both can trip `isSlowTestHost()`'s load-average branch), the 45 s budget is above that ceiling, so a slow settle surfaces as the generic `Test timed out in 15000ms` instead of the precise assertion. `vi.waitFor` still returns the moment its callback stops throwing, so this only affects already-failing tests; the flaking lane (`ecs-qwen-*`, 60 s ceiling) gets the full budget.
- Not validated / out of scope: does not touch `embedded-harness-scheduler.test.ts`'s `claim`-count assertion, which failed once today for a different reason (fake-timer ordering, 18–19 calls against an expected 20); that one is a separate defect and should not be papered over with a timeout.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — test-only.

## Linked Issues

Related auto-filed `Main CI failed` issues for this file: #14406, #14023. Not marking `Closes` — a green run cannot prove the flake is gone; the real oracle is whether this failure class stops recurring on `main` CI.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Read the diff as two things: one constant, and a mechanical substitution of `timeout: 10_000` with it. Confirm the constant sits below the 60 s per-test ceiling (`packages/cli/vitest.config.ts`), and confirm the three pre-existing `isSlowTestHost()` sites still read as they did — this change generalises their policy rather than inventing another number.

Then check the failure mode is still observable: force `isSlowTestHost()` to return false on a loaded host and the file still fails the same way; that is the intended behaviour, not a regression.
